key_point: The answer was in your hands all along
title: The answer was in your hands all along
caption: In Metal Gear Solid, you need Meryl's codec frequency to move on. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #metalgearsolid #konami

instagram.caption:
In Metal Gear Solid, you have to call Meryl on the codec, but nobody tells you her frequency in the game.

Colonel Campbell only says it is on the back of the CD case. Many players searched every corner of Shadow Moses before getting it.

The number 140.15 was printed on the real box in a screenshot. People who rented the game without the case were completely stuck.
